column3: “The people of Ammon” is rendered “the sons of Ammon,” as throughout this chapter.
“Do loyalty” is rendered “show kindness,” and “comfort” as “console.”
“Officials” is rendered “princes”; the question “Is David honoring your father in your eyes?” is rendered “Do you think that David is honoring your father,” and “explore” as “search.”
“People went” is rendered “certain persons went”; “grow back” is rendered “grow,” and NASB supplies “then.”
NASB supplies “of it”; “the warriors” is rendered “the mighty men.”
“Deployed battle” is rendered “drew up in battle array,” and “the open country” as “the field.”
“The face of the battle was against him, face and back” is rendered “the battle was set against him in front and in the rear”; NASB has “they arrayed themselves” where the Hebrew has “he deployed.”
NASB keeps the Chronicles spelling “Abshai.” “Deployed” is rendered “arrayed themselves.”
“You will become deliverance for me” is rendered “you shall help me,” and “I will deliver you” as “I will help you.”
“Show ourselves strong” is rendered “show ourselves courageous”; NASB supplies “the sake of” and renders “he will do” as a wish (“may the LORD do”).
“Drew near … before Aram for the battle” is rendered “drew near to the battle against the Arameans.”
NASB keeps the spelling “Abshai.” “Went the city towards” is rendered “entered the city.”
“Before Israel” is rendered “by Israel,” and “was before them” as “leading them.”
“Came to them” is rendered “came upon them,” and “deployed” as “drew up in formation” and “drew up in battle array.”
